officialSources.observation: Current official Uttar Pradesh Bhu-Naksha public viewer. Its JavaScript configuration identifies the first-party API base https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver, with public level lookup, GIS-code, and map-extent routes. The site describes cadastral map access by district, tehsil, and village.

Official Uttar Pradesh cadastral-map digitization dashboard for Etah district. It reports Aliganj, Eta, and Jlesar tehsils and district totals; the rows show linked/verified village and mapsheet counts, with some remaining georeferencing counts. This is coverage evidence, not a parcel geometry response.
Official Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh portal operated by the Revenue Board; its public description links land-record and Bhu-Naksha services.
Official Etah district administration website; it establishes the local district administration context but did not expose a public parcel API in the bounded request.

requests.outcome: Official district site loaded; no parcel service configuration was exposed in the bounded HTML inspection.

Current JavaScript viewer shell loaded. Its unchanged public JavaScript/configuration was inspected to identify the first-party API routes; no credentials, private token, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe lookup was used.
Official Etah district digitization report loaded. It named Aliganj, Eta, and Jlesar tehsils and supplied village/mapsheet coverage counts.
Returned Uttar Pradesh and the public hierarchy District, Tehsil, Village.

Returned public district, tehsil, and village lookup rows. Etah district code 201 and Etah tehsil code 01008 were confirmed; entries included Etah urban/revenue-village names with hasData false. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, or account fields were requested.
Returned GIS code 0920101008 for the selected Etah route.

For gisLevels 09,201,01008,221383 and 09,201,01008, the public response returned xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax all 0.0 and GIS code 0920101008. This is an unavailable/zero extent response for the selected route, not evidence of citywide parcel absence. No geometry or native parcel identity was retrieved.
Bounded request did not connect within 10 seconds; no retry with disabled TLS or authentication was made.
